# opencollective_collective (Data Source)

Looks up an Open Collective collective by `id`, `slug` or `github_handle`. Exactly one of these must be set.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a collective by its slug (https://opencollective.com/babel)
data "opencollective_collective" "by_slug" {
  slug = "babel"
}

# Look up a collective by its public ID
data "opencollective_collective" "by_id" {
  id = "dgm9bnk8-0437xqry-ejpvzeol-jdayw5re"
}

# Look up a collective by its linked GitHub handle
data "opencollective_collective" "by_github" {
  github_handle = "babel/babel"
}

output "babel_host" {
  value = data.opencollective_collective.by_slug.host_slug
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `github_handle` (String) GitHub handle (`org` or `org/repo`) linked to the collective.
- `id` (String) Public identifier of the collective.
- `slug` (String) Slug of the collective, as used in its URL (e.g. `babel` for `https://opencollective.com/babel`).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `currency` (String) Currency code of the collective, e.g. `USD`.
- `description` (String) Short description of the collective.
- `host_id` (String) Public identifier of the fiscal host, if any.
- `host_slug` (String) Slug of the fiscal host, if any.
- `image_url` (String) URL of the collective's logo.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the collective is active (has a host and can receive contributions).
- `is_approved` (Boolean) Whether the collective has been approved by its host.
- `is_archived` (Boolean) Whether the collective is archived.
- `legacy_id` (Number) Legacy numeric identifier of the collective.
- `long_description` (String) Long description of the collective (HTML).
- `name` (String) Public name of the collective.
- `social_links` (Attributes List) Links to the collective's profiles on other platforms. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--social_links))
- `tags` (List of String) Tags assigned to the collective.
- `type` (String) Account type, e.g. `COLLECTIVE`.
- `website` (String) Website of the collective.

<a id="nestedatt--social_links"></a>
### Nested Schema for `social_links`

Read-Only:

- `type` (String) Platform type, e.g. `GITHUB` or `WEBSITE`.
- `url` (String) URL of the profile.
